name: The Flying Machine Airport
summary: Apothecary Zamah sends you to silence The Flying Machine Airport above Stonetalon. Carry her Toxic Fogger into the Venture Company’s logging grounds and strike at the cartel’s link to the outside world.

sections.title: A Silent Delivery
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah prepares Apothecary Lydon’s toxin for the Venture Company. The tauren seek to protect Stonetalon from deforestation and ravaging machinery, while the Forsaken answer with a different approach. Zamah targets the cartel’s connection beyond the mountains instead of its foot soldiers or loggers. A rumored copter pad carries light cargo and messages between Stonetalon and distant corporate offices.

sections.title: Cragpool's Sky Port
sections.body: The Venture Company’s copter pad sits high in the Cragpool Lake area, south of the great waterwheel. The small platform serves lightweight flying machines, not massive zeppelins. You are sent to set off the Toxic Fogger there, filling the pad with toxic vapor before a pilot, courier, or mechanic can alert the company’s commanders.

sections.title: Forsaken Pragmatism
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah makes no apology for using chemical warfare against the goblins. She believes the Venture Company deserves worse for what it does to the land. Her lesson from Undercity doctrine is plain: the Horde must not shy from dark paths when they lead to victory.

faq.q: Where is the flying machine airport located?
faq.answer: The Venture Company copter pad sits in the Cragpool Lake area of the Stonetalon Mountains, south of the massive industrial waterwheel. Its raised wooden platform overlooks the lake’s southern bend.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Zamah want this site poisoned?
faq.answer: Zamah wants to sever the Venture Company’s communications and light supply lines between Stonetalon and its remote headquarters. She hopes poisoning the pad will cripple goblin flight crews and carry the toxin back to their corporate leaders.

Apothecary Zamah is an emissary of the Royal Apothecary Society, stationed in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff. She studies Kalimdor’s flora and fauna and develops alchemical weapons for the Forsaken and the Horde.

faq.q: Why is the Horde using chemical weapons here?
faq.answer: The Forsaken use chemical weapons with ruthless pragmatism. Zamah believes the Venture Company’s destructive greed warrants merciless tactics, while her tauren allies favor spiritual healing and direct defense of the earth. To her, victory matters more than restraint.

faq.q: What kind of aircraft does the Venture Company use here?
faq.answer: The Venture Company uses small goblin flying machines and gyro-copters, not full-sized zeppelins. These agile craft carry high-priority messages and cargo over Stonetalon’s rugged mountain passes.

faq.q: What happens after the fogger is deployed?
faq.answer: After you release the fogger atop the pad, you flee before the vapors overtake you. Zamah considers the deployment a success and expects the poison to disrupt goblin logistics.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you see the Toxic Fogger as familiar work: Undercity’s alchemical skill can solve problems brute force cannot.

As a tauren, you abhor the Venture Company’s destruction of Stonetalon. Using toxins at a Forsaken apothecary’s urging tests the balance between reverence for the earth-mother and battlefield pragmatism.
As an engineer, you can see the crude, practical design of the goblin copter pad, built for the Venture Company’s rapid travel across rugged mountains.
As a member of the Horde, you help cut off the Venture Company from outside aid. Striking its air transit deals a critical blow to its supply lines.
